shortDescription: Manage patches in an Oracle environment

options.name: conflict_check
options.description: Should a conflict check be run before applying a patch. If the check errors the module exits with a failure

options.name: ocm_response_file
options.description: The OCM responsefile needed for OPatch versions < '12.2.0.1.5' (basically for DB/GI versions < 12.1)

options.name: opatch_minversion
options.description: The minimum version of opatch needed If this key is set, a comparison is made between existing version and opatch_minversion If existing < opatch_minversion an error is raised

options.name: opatchauto
options.description: Should the patch be applied using opatchato If set to true, the task has to run as 'root'

options.name: oracle_home
options.description: The home which will be patched

options.name: patch_base
options.description: Path to where the patch is located e.g /nfs/patches/12.1.0.2/27468957

options.name: patch_version
options.description: The patch version e.g 12.2.0.1.180417 This key is mandatory if you're applying a 'opatchauto' type of patch

options.name: rolling
options.description: Should a patch installed in rolling upgrade mode?

options.name: state
options.description: Should a patch be applied or removed present = applied, absent = removed, opatchversion = returns the version of opatch

options.name: stop_processes
options.description: Stop Instances and Listener before applying a patch in ORACLE_HOME
